versions.changelog: 新增 QuantaAlpha Alpha158_20 兼容持仓因子评分：六个价量因子、训练/样本外验证、腾讯复权日线、同行相对暴露；增强确定性随机对照与回归测试。仅研究模拟，不接券商。
Add optional QuantaAlpha factor mining and Qlib backtesting with an isolated pinned runtime, explicit data bootstrap, OpenClaw model bridge, and research-only safety controls.
Add Tencent public-data OHLCV factor research with cached data, point-in-time signal lag, out-of-sample evaluation, and random controls.
新增 Vibe-Trading 0.1.14 独立环境引导与非对话式 Alpha Zoo 因子横评（462 因子/5 个库）；新增 run_factor_research，保持仅研究模拟、无 LLM 和无券商下单边界。
新增可审计的均线、MACD、KDJ、量价研究模板与完整收盘后观察、回测用例；保持仅研究和模拟边界。
新增可审计的均线、MACD、KDJ、量价研究模板，以及完整的收盘后观察与回测用例；保持仅研究和模拟边界。
3.5.1: 补充行情、选股、回测、预警、AI4Trade 与多智能体投研的中文使用用例。
3.5.0: 默认复用 OpenClaw 模型，修复 TradingAgents 0.7 兼容性，更新中文使用文档。

AI4Trade integration: fixed-host, environment-token client for signal feeds, market intelligence, Polymarket public data, account/position reads, and explicitly confirmed signal publishing, follow, reply, point-exchange, and one-shot heartbeat actions. Remote data is marked untrusted; no automatic copy trading or background monitoring.

Security hardening: restrict DSA credential flow to loopback hosts, use HTTPS for Tencent quote and K-line fallbacks, validate six-digit stock codes, fix backtest sell accounting, document data flows, and exclude local portfolio/cache metadata from uploads.
v3.1.1: 优化A股全市场选股与持仓管理，新增ML未来5日方向预测(RF+GB)，完成全量配置脱敏与隐私清理
